facts.text: You play the CT side on Inferno.
The bomb has not been planted; about 84 s remain on the round clock.
The bomb has not been planted and its carrier has not been located.
1 of your 2 alive players carry a defuse kit.
Your team has 2 smokes, 3 flashes, 1 molotov and 2 HE grenades left.
The attackers detonated a molotov in Second Mid 16 s ago.
Your team is positioned: 2 in Banana.
One attacker was spotted in Back Alley 2 s ago with a Desert Eagle.
The position of one attacker is unknown.

Rotate a player towards Back Alley

Use utility to delay the first contact
Listen and read footsteps before moving
Probe with a trade behind the prober
Fall back but hold one angle
Rotate one player and keep the rest in place
Rotate two players and leave one behind

debrief.whyItWorks: Moving weight towards where the attackers were seen puts more defenders on the likely point of contact. Here, 2 players faced 2 with about 84 seconds left.
debrief.cost: It thins another area and can be punished by a fake.
debrief.assumption: The sighting reflects the real intent and is not a fake.
debrief.breaksWhen: The attackers were showing the position to pull a rotation and hit the area that was left thin.

evidenceReview.explanation: A sighting narrows where contact is likely, but its value falls quickly with age. That sighting was about 2 seconds old.
Unaccounted-for opponents are the main risk to any committed plan and the main reason to gather information. Here 1 attacker could not be placed.
The round clock bounds how long any plan can take. Here the round clock stood near 84 seconds.

debrief.followupReview: The proposed best answer to the new information was: Adjust the setup to the new information. Reasoning: the new information shows where an opponent is or what utility they have used, so adapting the plan is worth more than repeating it.
debrief.strongestAlternative: The closest alternative was to hold the current setup, keeping trades in place at the cost of the initiative.

counterfactual.changedFact: The sighting is known to be a deliberate fake.
counterfactual.effect: The rotation leaves the real target thin, and holding the setup becomes stronger.

reveal.principle: Move weight only for information you trust: a fresh sighting justifies a rotation, an old or unconfirmed one usually does not.
